description: List resource instance addresses in the current Terraform state (terraform state list), optionally filtered. Read-only: never locks, never refreshes. With a remote backend this reads S3/GCS/HCP using the server's credentials; a non-default workspace that does not exist is refused (reading it would create it).

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized). Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

filter.description: Case-sensitive substring of the address, e.g. 'module.network' or 'aws_instance.'

id.description: Only the instance whose id attribute equals this (terraform state list -id)

name: tf_state_addresses
